title: Бытие 17 — Genesis 17
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.translation: You will be the father of many nations.
cases.explain: The future of быть (будешь) takes its predicate noun in the instrumental → отцом.

cases.translation: I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.
cases.explain: After множество (a multitude of), the counted noun takes the genitive plural → народов.

cases.sentence: В тот же самый день Авраам взял своего ___ Измаила.
cases.translation: That same day Abraham took his son Ishmael.
cases.explain: Direct object of взял (took); for animate masculine nouns the accusative equals the genitive → сына.

cases.sentence: Я отдам вечное владение тебе и твоим ___.
cases.translation: I will give an everlasting possession to you and to your descendants.
cases.explain: The recipient of отдам (give) goes in the dative → потомкам.

cases.sentence: Всю землю ___ я отдам тебе и твоим потомкам.
cases.translation: I will give you and your descendants all the land of Canaan.
cases.explain: Possession — the land of Canaan — is expressed by the genitive → Ханаана.

cases.sentence: Все мужчины в ___ Авраама были обрезаны.
cases.translation: All the men in Abraham's house were circumcised.
cases.explain: В marking a location (no motion) takes the prepositional → доме.

cases.translation: She will become a mother of nations.
cases.explain: The verb стать (to become) takes its predicate noun in the instrumental → матерью.

cases.sentence: От тебя я произведу народы, и от тебя произойдут ___.
cases.translation: From you I will bring forth nations, and kings will come from you.
cases.explain: Цари is the subject of произойдут (will come), so it takes the nominative → цари.

reading.ru: Аврааму было девяносто девять лет, когда он был обрезан, а его сыну Измаилу было тринадцать.
reading.question: How old was Abraham when he was circumcised?
reading.explain: The text says Abraham was ninety-nine and Ishmael thirteen when they were circumcised.

reading.question: What did God promise Abraham would become?
reading.explain: God declared that Abraham would be the father of a multitude of nations.

reading.ru: Именно твоя жена Сара родит тебе сына, и ты назовешь его Исаак.
reading.question: What was Abraham to name the son Sarah would bear?
reading.explain: God said Sarah would bear a son whom Abraham should name Isaac.

reading.ru: Он будет отцом двенадцати правителей, и я произведу от него великий народ, но завет мой я заключу с Исааком, которого Сара родит себе к этому времени в следующем году.
reading.question: With whom would God establish His covenant?
reading.explain: Though Ishmael would be blessed, God would establish His covenant with Isaac.

reading.ru: В тот же самый день Авраам взял своего сына Измаила и всех, кто был рожден в его доме или куплен за деньги, всех людей мужского пола в доме, и обрезал их, как сказал ему Бог.
reading.question: What did Abraham do that same day?
options: Circumcised Ishmael and all the males of his house
reading.correct: Circumcised Ishmael and all the males of his house
reading.explain: Abraham circumcised Ishmael and every male of his household that very day, as God commanded.

reading.ru: Закончив говорить с Авраамом, Бог поднялся от него.
reading.question: What happened when God finished speaking with Abraham?
reading.explain: When He had finished speaking, God went up from Abraham.
